headline: Silverton Logistics appoints new regional sales director
body: Silverton Logistics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Silverton Logistics opens new production line in Austin
body: Silverton Logistics commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Silverton Logistics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Silverton Logistics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Austin. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Silverton Logistics faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Silverton Logistics. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Silverton Logistics wins quality award from industry association
body: Silverton Logistics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.
